diff --git a/mail/components/extensions/ExtensionToolbarButtons.sys.mjs b/mail/components/extensions/ExtensionToolbarButtons.sys.mjs
index bdd306a477f..a8e101e93a7 100644
--- a/mail/components/extensions/ExtensionToolbarButtons.sys.mjs
+++ b/mail/components/extensions/ExtensionToolbarButtons.sys.mjs
@@ -95,8 +95,8 @@ export function getIconData(icons, extension) {
 
   const style = [];
   const getImageSet = (imgSize, theme) => `image-set(
-    url("${getIcon(imgSize, theme)}"),
-    url("${getIcon(imgSize * 2, theme)}") 2x
+    url("${getIcon(imgSize, theme)}") 1dppx,
+    url("${getIcon(imgSize * 2, theme)}") 2dppx
   )`;
   const getStyle = (name, imgSize) => {
     style.push([`--webextension-${name}`, getImageSet(imgSize, "default")]);
diff --git a/mail/components/extensions/test/browser/browser_ext_spacesToolbar.js b/mail/components/extensions/test/browser/browser_ext_spacesToolbar.js

--- a/mail/components/extensions/test/browser/browser_ext_spacesToolbar.js
+++ b/mail/components/extensions/test/browser/browser_ext_spacesToolbar.js
@@ -179,11 +179,13 @@ async function test_spaceToolbar(background, selectedTheme, manifestIcons) {
       // Check menuitem icon.
       const menuitemStyles = window.getComputedStyle(menuitem);
       Assert.equal(
-        menuitemStyles.listStyleImage,
+        menuitemStyles
+          .getPropertyValue("--menuitem-icon")
+          .replaceAll(/\s+/g, ""),
         makeIconSet(
           icons[selectedTheme],
           icons.default || icons[selectedTheme]
-        ),
+        ).replaceAll(/\s+/g, ""),
         `Icon of menuitem ${id} with theme ${selectedTheme} should be correct.`
       );

       );
